questions.stemEn: A neonate has a vascular tumor on the back with thrombocytopenia and prolonged coagulation studies. What is the most likely cause of the laboratory abnormalities?
questions.explanationAr: التجميع يربط vascular tumor مع severe thrombocytopenia واستهلاك coagulation factors بـ Kasabach-Merritt phenomenon. ويذكر أن الحالة ترتبط خصوصًا بـ kaposiform hemangioendothelioma أو tufted angioma.
questions.clinicalPearl: Kasabach-Merritt phenomenon is a consumptive coagulopathy associated with specific vascular tumors, not typical infantile hemangioma.

questions.stemEn: A 2-month-old has a progressively enlarging hemangioma causing ptosis. What is the best next step in management?
questions.explanationAr: وجود periocular hemangioma يهدد الرؤية ويُعد functional impairment؛ التجميع يختار propranolol كـ first-line systemic therapy إذا لا توجد contraindications.
questions.clinicalPearl: Periocular infantile hemangioma threatening vision is high risk and generally requires active treatment rather than observation.

questions.stemEn: A 4-month-old with periocular hemangioma has not improved with intralesional and systemic corticosteroids. What is the next best management?
questions.explanationAr: التجميع يختار propranolol لأنه لم يُجرّب بعد وهو العلاج الأول للحالات التي تهدد الوظيفة أو تسبب disfigurement، بينما surgery ليست الخطوة الأولى عادةً.
questions.clinicalPearl: Propranolol has largely replaced systemic corticosteroids as first-line therapy for complicated infantile hemangioma.
